### Centrality

```{r}
centralities_df <- readRDS(here::here("output/tables/centralities_df.rds"))
species_names_df_raw <- read.csv(here::here("data/species_names_checks.csv"))

centralities_df <- centralities_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(annotated_name = species) %>%
  left_join(species_names_df_raw |> select(annotated_name, species_name),
            by = "annotated_name") |>
  dplyr::mutate(species_name = gsub(".", "-", species_name, fixed = TRUE),
                species_name = gsub(" ", "_", species_name, fixed = TRUE))

centralities_df
```


### island characteristics

```{r}
sp_island_df <- readRDS(here::here("output/temporal_output/sp_island_id.rds"))

sp_island_df <- sp_island_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(species_name = gsub(".", "-", species_name, fixed = TRUE),
                species_name = gsub(" ", "_", species_name, fixed = TRUE))

sp_island_df

```

### network snail numbers

```{r}
species_counts <- sp_island_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(island) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_snails_island = n_distinct(species_name))

# Join this count back to the original dataframe
sp_island_df <- sp_island_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(species_counts, by = "island")
```



### speciation rates

```{r}
## Importing tree
tree <- read.tree(here::here("speciation_rates/clads/cleannames_tree_041024.txt"))

## Rescaling branch lengths by a scale of 10 to reflect time
tree$edge.length <- tree$edge.length * 10


## Making sure the tree is still ultrametric
is.ultrametric(tree)

## Replacing "." in species names for CLaDS not to complain
tree$tip.label <- gsub(".", "-", tree$tip.label, fixed = TRUE)

load(here::here("speciation_rates/clads/naesiotus_clads_rates.RData"))

bamm.data <- getEventData(tree, here::here("speciation_rates/bamm/event_data.txt"), burnin = 0.1)

```



### Get posterior samples from claDS


```{r}
summary(CladsOutput)

summary(CladsOutput$rtt_chains)

posterior_distributions <- lapply(1:274, function(species_index) {
  unlist(lapply(1:3, function(chain_index) CladsOutput$chains[[chain_index]][[species_index]]))
})

names(posterior_distributions) <- tree$tip.label  # Assign species names if available

summary(posterior_distributions)


```



### Get posterior samples from BAMM

```{r}
# Assuming your BAMM output is stored in an object called 'bamm_output'

# Extract the number of posterior samples and the number of species
num_samples <- length(bamm.data$tipLambda)
num_species <- length(bamm.data$tipLambda[[1]])

# Initialize a data frame to store the posterior samples
posterior_samples <- data.frame()

# Loop through each posterior sample to extract speciation and extinction rates
for (i in 1:num_samples) {
  # Create a temporary data frame for each sample
  sample_df <- data.frame(
    Species = bamm.data$tip.label, # Adjust if you have species names
    SpeciationRate = bamm.data$tipLambda[[i]],
    ExtinctionRate = bamm.data$tipMu[[i]],
    Sample = i
  )
  
  # Combine each sample's data into the main data frame
  posterior_samples <- rbind(posterior_samples, sample_df)
}

# Convert 'Species' to a factor or use actual species names if available
posterior_samples$Species <- as.factor(posterior_samples$Species)

# View the first few rows of the result
head(posterior_samples)

```

Plot posteriors

```{r}
# Initialize an empty list to store plots for each species
plots <- list()

# Loop over each species to create a density plot for its posterior distribution
for (species in unique(posterior_samples$Species)) {
  # Filter the data for the current species
  species_data <- subset(posterior_samples, Species == species)
  
  # Create the density plot for Speciation Rate of the current species
  p <- ggplot(species_data, aes(x = SpeciationRate)) +
    geom_density(fill = "red4", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = species, x = "Speciation Rate", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Add the plot to the list
  plots[[species]] <- p
}

# Arrange all species plots using ggarrange in a grid layout
ggarrange(plotlist = plots, ncol = 5, nrow = 5)  # Adjust ncol and nrow as needed

```





# Model


```{r}
library(MCMCglmm)


rate_samples <- list() # this will contain rate samples for each iteration

# Run MCMCglmm models for each sample set
for (i in 1:num_samples) {
    # Create a dataset with species_speciation_rate for this sample
    data_sample <- your_data
    data_sample$species_speciation_rate <- rate_samples[[i]]
    
    # Fit the model
    model <- MCMCglmm(PCA_centrality ~ species_speciation_rate + lineage_size + island_age + island_area, 
                      data = data_sample, 
                      family = "gaussian", 
                      prior = your_prior, 
                      nitt = 10000, burnin = 2000, thin = 10)
    
    # Save the posterior distribution for this sample set
    posterior_distributions[[i]] <- model$Sol
}

# Combine posterior distributions
combined_posterior <- do.call(rbind, posterior_distributions)

summary(combined_posterior)
```
